# netcup_servers (Data Source)

All servers of the netcup account (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_servers" "all" {}

output "server_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.netcup_servers.all.servers : s.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) Servers in the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the server is disabled.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname.
- `id` (Number) Server id.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `nickname` (String) Nickname.
